sections.title: Miami's manufacturing AI differentiation
sections.description: Miami's manufacturing AI market has several characteristics that distinguish it from other Sun Belt manufacturing markets.

blocks.heading: Latin American supply chain gateway
paragraphs: Miami's role as the gateway to Latin American commerce — PortMiami handles 80%+ of US trade with Latin America in some categories — creates supply chain AI applications that are unique to Miami. The bilingual supply chain documentation, multi-country customs compliance, and the specific logistics patterns of US-Latin America trade create AI requirements that Phoenix or Atlanta manufacturing AI engagements don't encounter.

blocks.heading: Florida's pharmaceutical distribution hub
paragraphs: Florida is the pharmaceutical destination for the Caribbean and Central American healthcare systems — Miami serves as both the manufacturing and distribution hub for pharmaceutical products flowing to Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, and other Caribbean markets. The DSCSA compliance requirements for this pharmaceutical re-export trade are specific to Florida's role.

blocks.heading: Nutraceutical industry concentration
paragraphs: The Miami metro area has an extraordinary concentration of nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturers — the combination of Florida's favorable business environment, the large bilingual consumer market, and the Latin American export opportunity has made South Florida the US's most concentrated nutraceutical manufacturing geography. FDA 21 CFR Part 111 compliance AI for nutraceutical manufacturing is a specifically Miami application.
